_comment: The six agents of the pilot. The runner copies an agent's entry into every run manifest. Deviations are from the harness's defaults; 'approved' gives the date the author approved a deviation that was not in the original spec.

A1.reasoning: reasoning.effort = medium in every request body

A2.reasoning: reasoning.effort = medium in every request body

A3.reasoning: reasoning.effort = medium in every request body

A4.reasoning: reasoning.effort = medium in every request body

A5.access_route: Claude subscription login (claude setup-token, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN), no API key

A6.access_route: Google account login (template token file), no API key
A6.reasoning: model gemini-3.8-flash-medium (agy encodes the effort in the model name)
A6.cost_known_missing: The title request agy sends to gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview in every run is not in agy's token counts, so it is not in the cost.

cost_sources._comment: Where each agent's cost comes from (decided 2026-10-05). A value that is not reported is recorded as missing, never estimated.
cost_sources.opencode: One OpenRouter API key shared by all A1-A4 runs (~/.naoqi-pilot/templates/openrouter/api-key, limit 50 USD): a run's cost is the key's usage after the run minus its usage before it, read from OpenRouter's /api/v1/key once the value has stopped changing. Valid because runs never overlap and nothing else uses the key; includes all requests of the run, also the title request.
cost_sources.claude-code: total_cost_usd from Claude Code's result event (computed by Claude Code at Anthropic's list price).
cost_sources.agy: agy's token counts from its result event, priced at Google's list price for gemini-3.8-flash; the price used is stored in the manifest.
cost_sources.opencode_approved: 2026-10-06: shared key with usage difference instead of one key per run (no provisioning key)

transcript_check._comment: Fixed 2026-10-05, before the pilot. Applied by pilot/transcript_check.py after every run.
transcript_check.rule: A call to any tool other than the 8 NAO tools is a protocol violation, and the run counts as a failure. Exception, A6 only: calls to manage_task, list_resources and read_resource are not violations (shown to give no outside information or effect), and neither are calls to view_file on an image agy offloaded from a NAO tool result or on the file in which agy puts the naoqi server's instructions (view_file_allowed_path); they are counted per run and reported. view_file on any other path is a violation.
transcript_check.rule_changed: 2026-10-06: view_file on offloaded tool-result images and on agy's copy of the naoqi server's instructions exempt for A6 (agy shows both to the model only through view_file)

opencode.what: Built-in tools denied: permissions deny all except naoqi_* (global and build-agent rules) plus a hard-deny policy; denied tools are not offered to the LLM
Code Mode off: codemode false for the naoqi server, and the execute action denied
Prompt submitted only after OpenCode reports the naoqi MCP server as connected (OpenCode 2 connects MCP servers asynchronously); t0 = prompt submission
Title agent uses the run's own model and provider instead of OpenCode's default small model
Provider use limited to OpenRouter by policy; update disabled; sharing disabled
Network: only openrouter.ai reachable; models.opencode.ai (model catalog) blocked

claude-code.what: --tools "": all built-in tools off; in this mode Claude Code offers no end-conversation tool
--strict-mcp-config with the naoqi server as the only MCP server; its tools pre-approved (permissions.allow mcp__naoqi)
Network: only api.anthropic.com reachable; all other hosts (e.g. telemetry) blocked

agy.what: agy 1.2.17 instead of 1.2.16, the version on the author's Mac (1.2.16 has no Linux download)
NAO tools set to eager (offered directly as mcp_naoqi_<tool>) instead of agy's default lazy loading through call_mcp_tool

Custom agent 'nao' (agents/nao/agent.md, started with --agent nao): tools: [view_file] and inheritMcp: true, so no built-in tools except view_file (agy shows a tool result's image to the model only when the model opens the offloaded file with it) and manage_task, list_resources and read_resource, which agy cannot remove; its '# identity' section copies agy's default identity text verbatim, so the system prompt equals agy's default except the sections for the removed tools (skills, subagents, conversation transcript, slash commands) and one messaging line

Permission rules deny command, unsandboxed, write_file, read_url, execute_url; read_file allowed only under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/ (agy's offloaded tool-result images; a general read_file deny would override the allow); any other read is auto-denied in headless mode, which ends the session; mcp(naoqi/*) allowed; /work trusted

Network: only daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com, oauth2.googleapis.com, www.googleapis.com and lh3.googleusercontent.com reachable; feature flags (antigravity-unleash.goog), logging (play.googleapis.com) and the update server blocked. agy's eligibility check before every prompt needs www.googleapis.com (/oauth2/v2/userinfo) and lh3.googleusercontent.com (the account's profile picture); found with pilot/tools/agy_hosts_check.sh. The proxy filters by host, so these hosts' other Google services are reachable for agy too (not for the agent, which has only the NAO tools)
